nodes.label: JLPT App Build Order & Timeline
nodes.rationale: 6-week MVP timeline. Phases ordered by dependency: Phase 0 setup, Phase 1 static content (everything depends on this), Phase 2 backend API in parallel, Phase 3 Expo UI, Phase 4 testing, Phase 5 post-MVP.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Static Content Curation
nodes.rationale: High priority because lesson screen cannot display if no JSON files exist. 125 hours total. Sources: KanjiVG for strokes, Jisho.org API for vocab, Tatoeba for examples, Forvo for audio.

nodes.label: DeepSeek Integration
nodes.rationale: Post-MVP AI integration for error explanations, contextual example generation, and personalized quizzes. Cheaper than ChatGPT, good quality for Japanese JLPT use case.

nodes.label: User Personas (Mina, Rio, Kenji)
nodes.rationale: Personas represent real friends in the study group. Mina=committed 30min/day, Rio=casual 10-15min/day, Kenji=perfectionist 45-60min/day. Used for feature prioritization: ask how Mina/Rio/Kenji would use feature X.

nodes.label: SQLite Optional Cache Decision
nodes.rationale: SQLite is NOT needed for MVP. Start without it (3-5 friends always have internet). Add in Phase 2 only if users complain about offline. Neon PostgreSQL is source of truth; TanStack Query handles client-side caching; SQLite is optional offline fallback only.

nodes.label: Data Flow Architecture
nodes.rationale: Neon PostgreSQL is always source of truth. Direction: Neon PostgreSQL -> Hono Backend -> Expo App -> TanStack Query (local cache). Friends activity polled every 30 seconds.

nodes.label: CLAUDE_CONTEXT AI Guidance Document
nodes.rationale: AI context file. Always paste this before asking Claude coding questions to ensure correct stack suggestions (Zustand not Redux, TanStack Query not AsyncStorage, Better Auth not rebuild).

nodes.label: Code Review Workflow (Analyze Before Copy-Paste)
nodes.rationale: 4-step workflow: Ask Claude (with CLAUDE_CONTEXT) -> Review code against checklist -> Decide (good/needs changes/bad) -> Implement. Ensures code quality before copy-paste.

nodes.label: Code Review Checklist
nodes.rationale: Must-have: TypeScript no-any, TanStack Query for API, functional components, no Redux, no AsyncStorage, env vars for backend URL, credentials:include, error handling. Common issues: wrong state management (Redux), hardcoded URLs, missing credentials:include, class components, any types, AsyncStorage.

nodes.label: Backend Implementation Status (Complete)
nodes.rationale: ~1200 lines of backend code. 8 DB tables, 14 API endpoints, Better Auth, SRS algorithm, friend codes, leaderboards, activity polling. Zero cost infrastructure on free tiers.

nodes.label: N5 Curriculum (100-Day Plan)
nodes.rationale: Days 1-10: Hiragana (46 chars). Days 11-20: Katakana (46 chars). Days 21-60: Core Vocabulary (400 words). Days 61-80: Kanji (100 chars). Days 81-100: Grammar (20 patterns). Output: user is N5 ready.

nodes.label: Spaced Repetition System (SRS / SM-2)
nodes.rationale: Leitner/SM-2 algorithm. Items due for review every 1,3,7,14,30 days. Correct answer pushes back review date; wrong answer resets to 1-day gap.

nodes.label: Daily Lesson Screen
nodes.rationale: 4 phases: Learn (stroke animation + audio), Recognize (multiple choice quiz), Write (optional stroke tracing), Summary. Static progression same lesson for all users on Day N.

nodes.label: Friends & Leaderboards
nodes.rationale: 6-char friend codes (e.g. AB3F7Q) for discovery. Leaderboard tiers: streaks, items learned this week, time spent. Friends activity polled every 30 seconds for real-time feed.

nodes.label: DeepSeek Error Explanations (Phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Cache key: questionId_explanation. TTL 30 days. Reuse explanation for all users. Aggressive caching reduces repeat calls by 70%. Cost ~$200-250/month at scale after caching.

nodes.label: Technology Decisions Made
nodes.rationale: Backend: Hono (lightweight Edge native), Better Auth (free OSS), Drizzle (type-safe), Neon PostgreSQL (serverless free tier), Vercel Edge (Hono native fast cold starts). Content: 70-80% static (accuracy, offline, no API costs), 20-30% dynamic AI (error explanations, personalization), DeepSeek (cheaper than ChatGPT).

nodes.label: Cost Analysis ($0 Infrastructure)
nodes.rationale: Neon free tier (0.5 GB / 100 hrs/month). Vercel free (100k invocations/month). Better Auth, Hono, Drizzle all open-source. $0/month at 3-5 users. DeepSeek only cost: $0-50/month at scale.
